@realm:     Mentalism
@name:      Mind Merge
@category:  Base
@class:     Mentalist
#
# Format: <level> | <spell_name> | <area_effect> | <duration> | <range> | <type>
# A trailing '*' on the name marks a Concentration / continuing-effect spell.
#
 1 | Empathy | 1 target/rnd | 1 rnd/lvl(C) | 10' | Pm
 2 | Read Emotions | 1 target/rnd | 1 rnd/lvl(C) | 50' | Pm
 3 | Merge With Mentalist | caster+1 tgt | C | touch | U
 4 | Focus Merge | caster | C | self | U
 5 | Thoughts | 1 target/rnd | 1 rnd/lvl(C) | 100' | Fm
 6 | Mind Merge I | caster+1 tgt | C | touch | U
 7 | Prepare Merge | caster | C | self | U
 8 | Mind Merge II | caster+1 tgt | C | 100' | U
10 | Inner Thoughts | 1 target/rnd | 1 rnd/lvl | 100' | Fm
11 | Ready Merge | caster+1 tgt | C | 100'/lvl | U
13 | Mind Switch | caster+1 tgt | 1 day | touch | Fm
15 | Mind Scan | 1 target/rnd | 1 rnd/lvl(C) | 100' | Fm
18 | Mind Merge True | caster+1 tgt | C | 50'/lvl | U
20 | Mind Probe | 1 target/rnd | 1 rnd/lvl(C) | 100' | Fm
25 | Mind Switch True | caster+1 tgt | varies | touch | Fm
30 | Thought Steal | 1 target | 1 rnd/lvl(C) | 100' | Fm
50 | Ready Merge True | caster+1 tgt | C | unlimited | U

# Descriptions
@@ 1
Caster learns target’s basic feelings. The caster can concentrate on a new
target each round.
@@ 2
Caster learns target’s emotions in detail. The caster can concentrate on a new
target each round.
@@ 3
Allows two Mentalism spell users to communicate mentally and exchange power
points.
@@ 4
When cast before (within 1 minute) a Mind Merge spell or a Ready Merge spell
(an 11th+ level spell on this spell list in Spell Law), this spell allows the
caster to focus on a specific person as the target (that he has Mind Stored
previously). This spell allows certain spells to work even if the caster
doesn’s know the target’s exact location.
@@ 5
Caster receives surface thoughts from target. If target makes his RR by more
than 25 he realizes that someone is trying to read his thoughts. The caster
can concentrate on a new target each round.
@@ 6
Allows caster and target to interchange thoughts; if both are Mentalism spell
users they can interchange power points. They must be able to see each other
or the caster must know the exact location of the target or the caster must
use Focus Merge to locate the target (in all cases, the target must be within
range).
@@ 7
The caster prepares himself to be the target of a Mind Merge spell or Ready
Merge spell (an 11th+ level spell on this spell list in Spell Law), thus,
increases the range of the “incoming” spell. The increased range is equal to
the original range times the number of power points used to cast the Prepare
Merge spell (e.g., if a caster uses 18 PPs, the range is 18 times normal).
@@ 8
As Mind Merge I, except range is 100'.
@@ 10
As in Thoughts, except caster also learns reasoning and thought patterns
behind surface thoughts.
@@ 11
As in Mind Merge I, except for range and caster and target must have Merged
before and it is instantaneous.
@@ 13
Target and caster switch minds and spell casting abilities. Target (in
caster’s body) is in a coma if he is not also a Mentalist. If the target is
unwilling, he may make a new RR every hour.
@@ 15
As in Inner Thoughts, except caster can also scan target’s conscious memories,
at a rate of 1 scene every round.
@@ 18
As Mind Merge I, except for range and caster must know the exact location of
the target mentally or through some other means.
@@ 20
As in Mind Scan, except caster can probe target’s subconscious memories (i.e.,
all experiences).
@@ 25
As in Mind Switch, except lasts until the caster decides to return to his own
body.
@@ 30
Caster can remove one thought or memory from the target’s mind each round.
@@ 50
As in Ready Merge, except range is unlimited.
